Legal.termsIntro: These Terms & Conditions govern the use of iDesignStudio.ro and the purchase of products offered through it. By placing an order, you confirm that you have read and accept these terms.
Legal.termsRoleBody: IDESIGN STUDIO S.R.L. acts as the merchant, selling its own event decor and custom stationery products shown on this site directly. The same company is the legal entity that sells the products and issues the invoice for every order.
Legal.termsProductsBody: All prices shown on the site are in RON (Romanian lei). IDESIGN STUDIO S.R.L. is not a VAT payer, so prices do not include VAT. We reserve the right to change prices and product availability without prior notice; such changes do not affect already-confirmed orders.
Legal.termsPaymentBody: You can pay online by card (Visa, Mastercard), securely processed by NETOPIA Payments, an authorized payment processor; your card details are never stored on our servers. Alternatively, you can pay by cash on delivery, in cash to the courier when the parcel arrives, for an additional cash-on-delivery fee of 3.99 RON.
Legal.termsDeliveryBody: Personalized products (invitations, stationery, 3D-printed decor) are made to order. The estimated delivery time is made up of processing/production time of 1-2 business days, plus courier transit time. We currently ship within Romania only, via courier (Sameday), with an estimated delivery time of 1-2 business days after dispatch. Shipping is a flat fee of 19.99 RON, which includes protective packaging for fragile items, and is free for orders of 200 RON or more. You'll receive a tracking number (AWB) as soon as your order ships.
Legal.termsReturnsBody: Personalized products (invitations, decor, or stationery made to your specifications — names, text, dates) cannot be returned or exchanged for reasons of personal preference once production has begun, per art. 16(c) of OUG no. 34/2014. You can cancel or modify a personalized order free of charge within 24 hours of placing it, or before production begins, whichever comes first — please contact us as soon as possible. Non-personalized products can be returned within 14 days of delivery, per the "Right of withdrawal" section below. If you receive a product that is damaged, defective, or different from what you ordered, see the "Legal guarantee of conformity" section.
Legal.termsWithdrawalBody: Under Romanian and EU consumer protection law (OUG no. 34/2014), you have the right to withdraw from a distance contract, without penalty and without giving a reason, within 14 calendar days of receiving the products. To exercise this right, notify us through the online form below or at the email address in the contact section, stating your order number and the products concerned. Send the products back within 14 days of your notice, to: IDESIGN STUDIO S.R.L., Str. Pictor Constantin Iliescu 1A, Râmnicu Vâlcea. The cost of return shipping is borne by the customer. We refund all amounts paid, including standard delivery, within 14 days of the date you notify us of the withdrawal, using the same payment method; we may postpone the refund until we receive the products back or proof that you have sent them, whichever comes first. Products personalized to your specifications are exempt from the right of withdrawal, per art. 16(c) of OUG no. 34/2014.

Legal.privacyIntro: This policy explains what personal data we collect through iDesignStudio.ro, how we use it, and your rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
Legal.privacyControllerBody: The controller of your personal data is:
Legal.privacyDataBody: We collect the data you give us directly: name, email address, and password (encrypted) when creating an account, as well as the data needed to process an order (products, amount, shipping address, when you place an order).
Legal.privacyUseBody: We use this data solely to manage your account, process orders, communicate with you about your orders (confirmations, notifications), and to respond to your requests when applicable.
Legal.privacyRightsBody: Under GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, and port your data, as well as the right to object to its processing. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at the address below.
Legal.termsContractBody: Your order is a distance contract for the purchase of the products in that order, valid for that order only. It is not a subscription and has no duration. The contract is concluded when your card payment is confirmed. For cash on delivery, it is concluded when you submit the order. If a card payment is not completed, the order is not registered.
Legal.termsRefusalBody: We may refuse or cancel an order if the card payment was not completed, if the details are incorrect or incomplete, if the payment looks suspicious, if previous deliveries repeatedly failed, or if we cannot reach you. If you have already paid, we refund the amount using the same payment method.
Legal.termsConformityBody1: Our products are covered by the legal guarantee of conformity under OUG 140/2021. We are liable for any lack of conformity that exists at delivery and appears within 2 years of receiving the product. If it appears within the first year, it is presumed to have existed at delivery.
Legal.termsConformityBody2: If you receive a product that is damaged, different from your order or defective, write to us at contact@idesignstudio.ro with your order number and a few photos. You can choose repair or replacement. We do it free of charge, within a reasonable time of at most 15 calendar days from your notice. If repair or replacement is not possible, you can choose a price reduction or a refund.
Legal.termsConformityBody3: The guarantee does not cover damage caused by improper use of the product or normal wear and tear. Your legal rights are not limited in any way.
Legal.termsAccountBody: An account is optional: you can order without one. You are responsible for keeping your password safe. We delete your account on request, within 30 days. We may suspend accounts that are used abusively.
Legal.termsIpBody: The texts, images, logo and design of the site belong to IDESIGN STUDIO S.R.L. and may not be copied without our consent. If you send us texts or images for personalized products, you confirm that you have the right to use them.
Legal.termsLiabilityBody: We do our best to keep the site running without interruption, but we are not liable for interruptions or errors caused by factors beyond our control (problems with internet or hosting providers, force majeure). We are not liable for inconvenience caused by incorrect data entered by the customer when ordering (for example a wrong address or phone number), nor for the content of third-party sites we link to. Nothing in these terms limits your statutory consumer rights.
Legal.termsLawBody: We first try to resolve any complaint amicably, at contact@idesignstudio.ro. If we cannot agree, you may turn to the competent Romanian courts. These terms are governed by Romanian law.
Legal.termsContactBody: Opening hours: Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00. We reply to messages within 5 working days at most.
Legal.privacyCookiesHeading: Cookies and data stored in your browser
Legal.privacyCookiesIntro: We only use what is needed for the site to work:
Legal.privacyCookiesItem1: a cookie with your chosen language (NEXT_LOCALE);
Legal.privacyCookiesItem2: a session cookie, if you log in to your account;
Legal.privacyCookiesItem3: in your browser, we keep your shopping cart and, during a payment, the last order you started.
Legal.privacyCookiesOutro: We do not use analytics, advertising or third-party trackers. The NETOPIA payment page has its own cookie policy.
